claims: A mortgage loan officer acts as the primary contact between borrowers and lenders.
A mortgage loan officer guides clients through the entire mortgage application, approval, and closing process for purchasing or refinancing real estate.
Mortgage loan officers advise on loan products.
Mortgage loan officers manage loan documentation.
A high school diploma or GED is required for mortgage loan officers.
Mortgage Loan Originators (MLOs) must register with the NMLS.
Mortgage Loan Originators require 20 hours of pre-licensing education.
Mortgage Loan Originators must pass a national exam with a 75% score.
Mortgage Loan Originators must pass a background check.
California requires 2 hours of additional specific coursework for Mortgage Loan Originators.
Mortgage loan officers guide borrowers to closing.
